## Objective
- Provide complete English/Turkish localization for Geyropoa while keeping language preference separate from saved story progress.
- Expand the game to 12 levels, with at least one hour of play before each ending; the user chose both substantial story content and timed pacing.

## Requirements
- Translate all game content and interface text into Turkish.
- Preserve story progress when changing languages; store language separately.
- Make each ending take at least an hour to reach, with many meaningful levels.

## Decisions
- Use the existing English and Turkish content in `i18n.js` and an English/Türkçe selector.
- Keep story state in `geyropoa-heart-tide-save-v1` and language in `geyropoa-language`.
- Combine authored story levels with timed gates.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added language selector, saved-language initialization and persistence, and localization for much of the interface and story rendering.
- Added eight English and Turkish journey scenes and began integrating them into route progression.
- Added a level-gate element, styles, a 12-level label, and timer state/logic scaffolding.

### Active
- Finish and reconcile the timed-level flow so all story paths reach an ending only after at least 60 minutes and appropriate levels.
- Complete English/Turkish localization for the new level and gate interface.
- Test story flow, language switching, replay, and saved-story continuation; review for untranslated text.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and finish the incomplete edits in `game.js` and `i18n.js`; ensure gate updates unlock choices/actions and the timer behaves correctly across refreshes and save continuation.
2. Add equivalent Turkish and English level/time text, and update any remaining outdated playtime copy.
3. Run syntax checks and interactive tests for both languages, all routes/endings, replay, and saved progress.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Language state, story progression, saving, level/timer logic, and rendering.
- `i18n.js`: English and Turkish interface and narrative data; latest edit is incomplete.
- `journey.js`: New bilingual route-level scenes.
- `index.html`: Language selector, level-gate markup, and script/style loading.
- `journey.css`: Level-gate styling.
- `styles.css`: Existing game and responsive styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Prior localization checks and a headless Chromium page-load smoke test passed before the new level/timer changes; interactive story flows were not yet verified.
- The latest `i18n.js` edit adds English level/gate strings only; Turkish counterparts and complete consistency checks remain outstanding.

## Objective
- Complete English/Turkish localization for Geyropoa while keeping language preference separate from saved story progress.
- Expand the game to 12 levels and require at least one hour before any ending.

## Requirements
- Translate all game content and interface text into Turkish.
- Preserve story progress when changing languages; store language separately.
- Provide substantial, meaningful story content and timed pacing before endings.

## Decisions
- Use the existing English and Turkish content in `i18n.js` and an English/Türkçe selector.
- Keep story state in `geyropoa-heart-tide-save-v1` and language in `geyropoa-language`.
- Combine authored journey scenes with timed gates.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added language selector, saved-language initialization and persistence, and much of the interface and story localization.
- Added eight bilingual journey scenes and integrated them into route progression.
- Added level-gate markup and styling, 12-level labeling, and timer scaffolding.
- Fixed malformed English and Turkish translation entries; `node --check game.js && node --check journey.js && node --check i18n.js` now passes.
- Added a one-second gate refresh timer and made ending gates wait until at least 60 minutes, including the truth route.
- Set route commitment at level 11 and endings at level 12; truth path starts its gate at level 11.
- Confirmed the page loads in headless Chromium using `chromium --headless --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --allow-file-access-from-files --dump-dom`.

### Active
- Test interactive English and Turkish flows, language switching, saved continuation, gate unlocking, replay, and every ending.
- Review remaining interface localization; static HTML defaults are English until `localizeShell()` runs, and Turkish apostrophe/casing in `storySuffix` may be inaccurate.
- Assess whether the 12-level progression matches pacing and user-facing labels; current minimum timing uses 5 minutes per level and 60 minutes for endings.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run interactive browser checks for both languages, routes, truth path, endings, and saved continuation.
2. Verify gates count down and unlock without user interaction, and that all endings remain inaccessible before 60 minutes even after refresh or continue.
3. Fix any localization or progression inconsistencies discovered; rerun syntax and browser smoke checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: State, localization, save/continue, progression, gate/timer, and rendering logic.
- `i18n.js`: English and Turkish interface and narrative data.
- `journey.js`: Eight bilingual route-level scenes.
- `index.html`: Language selector, gate element, story layout, and script/style loading.
- `journey.css`: Level-gate styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; repository status showed project files as untracked.
- Earlier interactive story flows have not been verified.
- Current timer gates levels at five-minute intervals and requires at least 60 minutes for ending nodes.
